text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Saddam Hussein chairs cabinet meeting.
- Iraqi intelligence directorate uncovers ring working for Israel.
- Saddam issues order to pardon agents of foreign intelligence services in Iraq if they give themselves up to the authorities.
- More worldwide interest in Saddam's speech on Army Day.
- Terrorist attack directed against the headquarters of Mujahideen Khalq in Baghdad.
- Pakistani president congratulates Saddam on the New Year.
- National Assembly speaker continues contacts in Indonesia.
- (The above were also carried by QADISSIYA, AL-IRAQ and JUMHOURIYA)
- Commentary lauds the United Arab Emirates' stands towards Iraq.
- Military Industrialization Commission says it is prepared to supply local markets with different kinds of computers.
